+    test "missing a member is non-exhaustive so the gate refuses to emit" do
+      assert blocked?()
+    end
+  end|)
+
+      slugs = Regex.scan(~r/@test def (\w+)\(\)/, out, capture: :all_but_first) |> List.flatten()
